title: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter
responsibility: Execute exact-model Claude or Codex tasks only through native isolation, fail closed before launch when scope/isolation is unavailable, and preserve safe provider diagnostics and observed usage.

inputs.name: constructor.execute
inputs.description: Existing process collaborator; tests may inject without bypassing sandbox.prepare.

inputs.name: constructor.sandbox
inputs.description: Defaults real native adapter; tests inject explicit identity/fake sandbox preserving logical provider argv.

inputs.name: run.input
inputs.description: Trusted scope required for native execution. Missing scope must not call sandbox or process. Sandbox wraps exact provider argv; resource guard stays outside sandbox and uses safe outer cwd.

inputs.name: taskProcess.input
inputs.description: Uses supplied trusted wrapper cwd/env. Resource admission and inherited lease fields stay outside the sandbox. Resolves/rejects only after owned process close.

inputs.name: command.selection
inputs.description: Exact provider/model/intelligence; returned argv is for the guarded run path, not direct unwrapped execution.

inputs.name: constructor.qualification
inputs.description: Third, trusted in-process host/test collaborator forwarded to launch qualification. Omission blocks all provider execution; never read from task data, CLI or environment.

outputs.name: run
outputs.description: Existing selected/reported model, usage, safe diagnostics retained. Sandbox cleanup only after execute resolves/rejects and owned processes exit. Execution cwd/env supplied by sandbox; original caller scope immutable. Production execution is blocked before launch until isolation is independently qualified.

outputs.name: command
outputs.description: Preserves exact requested model/intelligence and never-approval policy. Codex uses --sandbox danger-full-access only within the already-applied Harness OS boundary, avoiding nested Seatbelt; run still rejects missing scope or unavailable isolation before process launch. Claude argv unchanged.

outputs.name: ready
outputs.description: Check the same trusted launch qualification used by run, without preparing a sandbox or launching a provider. run rechecks before launch.

examples.expected: reject before sandbox.prepare and execute; no usage/no fallback
no execute; safe bounded prelaunch error; no provider usage
await process rejection and cleanup once; preserve cancellation semantics

errors.name: Existing provider boundaries
errors.description: No quota flag for authentication, unavailable model, isolation or unknown failures. Exact explicit model/intelligence preserved.
